newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine doctor refuses to quit Zaire war zone.
newsitem.headline: Argentine doctor refuses to quit Zaire war zone.

text.p: Representatives of an Argentine medical aid group flew on Tuesday to Zaire to persuade an ailing Argentine doctor in the war-torn city of Bukavu to follow the example of other aid workers and leave.
The Argentine group Doctors in Catastrophe said Dr. Abel Pasqualini was the only doctor who ignored calls by aid groups to leave Bukavu when fighting escalated in mid-October.
Pasqualini, who is suffering from a pancreas disorder, has also refused to heed the calls of his own organisation to return to Argentina for surgery.

"I am not going to drag him back. If he wants, he will come," Doctors in Catastrophe vice-president Ariel Umpierrez told reporters before boarding a flight to Zaire, accompanied by surgeon Gustavo Bustamante.
Umpierrez intends to negotiate with rebel leader Laurent Kabila to allow the group to continue working in the war zone.

But Umpierrez wants Pasqualini out: "Abel is a bull, as stubborn as an ass. The bad food, 20 hours work a day, seeing people die every day have caused him great stress. He's had pancreas problems for 20 days. He knows it's bad but he doesn't want to leave."
